I still can't confirm the year Bahattin Baysal received the TÜBİTAK Science Award, so I won't pick 1972 or 1985. The team note's reasoning doesn't hold up: it cites 1976 as the award's first year, which would rule out 1972. The TÜBİTAK award list or Turkish-language biographies of Baysal would settle it.
